parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance that contains the resource to which you want to attach tags.

> This parameter is required when you attach tags to a topic or a group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource to which you want to attach tags. Valid values:

*   **INSTANCE**
*   **TOPIC**
*   **GROUP**

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that you want to attach to the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons tag-resources --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --resource-type TOPIC --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --resource-id TopicA --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 TopicA --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType TOPIC
